'''Ox''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]].

==Biography==
Ox, along with the rest of [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]] that served on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], was sent on a medical supply run to [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]. On board the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] supply ship under the command of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]],<ref name="Brain Invaders" /> he<ref name="Episode Guide" /> was infected with one of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worms]] that had stowed aboard the ship and was subsequently mind-controlled and forced to attack the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] on the bridge. He then attacked the Jedi in the mess hall with the help of fellow clone [[Edge/Legends|Edge]], but was knocked unconscious. Ox, along with the rest of the ship's crew, was finally sterilized when Ahsoka ruptured the cooling tanks.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

==Equipment==
Ox carried a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] and a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] carbine. He also wore a backpack. He wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] that had blue markings and bore a striped sigil on his armored shoulder plates that resembled a stylized tiger face. Ox had his black hair combed back, making him stand out from his comrades.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />
